/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Assas.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AssassinateBountyAssTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Assas.descriptionZh: 一名 Grineer 领导者只会在我们干扰其多处前线行动的时候现身。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Assas.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AssassinateBountyCapTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Assas.nameZh: 捕获新任 Grineer 指挥官
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Assas.descriptionZh: 一名新任的 Grineer 指挥官已经不断在制造麻烦。捉住指挥官。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBountyCapTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.descriptionZh: 捉住他们的指挥官能对 Grineer 的分遣队造成士气上的打击。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBountyExtTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.descriptionZh: Grineer 的数量已经太多了。削弱他们。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBountyLibTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.descriptionZh: 将 Grineer 从他们在平野上的外哨赶出去

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBountySabTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.nameZh: 破坏 Grineer 的补给线
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Attri.descriptionZh: 重创 Grineer 的补给链。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Captu.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/CaptureBountyCapOneTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Captu.descriptionZh: 一名高阶的 Grineer 已经登陆到平野上。将他们带给 Lotus。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Captu.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/CaptureBountyCapTwoTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Captu.descriptionZh: 发现一名 Grineer 的间谍潜藏在希图斯村中。对 Grineer 施加压力将那位间谍逼出来。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyAssassinateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.descriptionZh: 合一众已被激怒。他们刚刚将一名信徒晋升为了指挥官。去把他降职至地狱。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyExterminateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.descriptionZh: 合一众的人数正在增加。他们在谋划一件大事。在他们再次向希图斯进军之前解决他们。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyLiberationTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.descriptionZh: 合一众正在强制招募教众。我们的人被他们掳走了，并且他们正在计划进行仪式来强戴面障。阻止他们。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyReclamationTile
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Narme.descriptionZh: 合一众已经被逼到了绝境。如果我们能夺取他们的资源，就能把他们赶出平野。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Recla.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBountyCacheTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Recla.descriptionZh: Grineer 夺走了一件奥罗金神器。找出他们已埋藏的神器。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Recla.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBountyCapTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Recla.descriptionZh: 一件对夜羽的重要道具已经被 Grineer 夺取。找出夺走神器的特工并捉住他。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Recla.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBountyTheftTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Recla.descriptionZh: 夜羽表示 Grineer 偷走了一件珍贵的奥罗金神器。把它偷回来。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Rescu.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/RescueBountyRescTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Rescu.descriptionZh: 一名 Ostron 人在平野上失踪了。找到他们并带他们回家。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Sabot.name: /Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/SabotageBountySabTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Jobs/Sabot.descriptionZh: 原型科技正要运送给 Grineer。扫遍整个平野直到你找到为止！

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyAreaDefName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 我们正试图重夺火卫二上的据点。我们需要夺回一些被感染者占据的旧基地。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyAssassName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 一个强大的感染者生物吓到了火卫二上的队伍。找到它，并消灭它。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyCrpSurvName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 帮助一个受困的 Corpus 特工完成他的任务，也就是将感染者样本带给英择谛来进行科研！……或是用来盈利？

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyEndlessAreaDefName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh:
感染者的数量不可能是无穷无尽的，对吗？如果我们杀得足够多的话后面就没有了……对吗？

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyEndlessExcavName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh:
覆盖火卫二的感染者"表皮"之下有着任君取用的资源。挖掘就是胜利！

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyEndlessPurifyName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh:
火卫二的古物总是供不应求。能带回来多少就带回来多少！

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyExcavName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 探索火卫二来获取有价值的地质核心样本。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyGrnSurvName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 一队被困在火卫二上的 Grineer 士兵启动了他们的求救信标。追踪他们，来看看你能提供什么帮助。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyKeysName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 许多资源储藏箱遗落在火卫二并且无人问津，找到它们，它们就是你的。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosBountyPurifyName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 在火卫二生物群落区寻找异常样本。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenusAssassinateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.descriptionZh: 一个全新的合一众蛛形机监工已经就位，并负责面障的通信传输。摧毁它，我们就能削弱他们的控制。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenusExterminateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.descriptionZh: 合一众正在大规模地进行招募行动。如果我们不能狠厉出击，那他们就会借此再度站稳脚跟。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenusPreservationTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.descriptionZh: 战场上出现了一架全新的合一众行动无人机。如果我们能得到它的数据块，就能知道合一众接下来的作战计划。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.name: /Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenusTheftExcavationTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/Narmer/.descriptionZh: 合一众已经将一处矿区划为他们的地盘，以便制造面障。我们必须阻止他们。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusAr.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/ArtifactJobAmbushTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusAr.descriptionZh: 税务官发现了一个奥罗金器物。拦截信使并夺走器物。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusAr.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/ArtifactJobExcavationTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusAr.descriptionZh: 在奈富的暴徒走狗们得逞前找到并取回一处挖掘地的遗物。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusAr.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/ArtifactJobRecoveryTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusAr.descriptionZh: 异世的航道特工正在夺取奈富在奥罗金残迹的占地权。协助他们解救自己的命运。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCh.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/ChaosJobAssassinateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCh.descriptionZh: 锁定他的资产来引诱出这位恶名昭彰的 Corpus 监工。然后杀死他。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCh.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/ChaosJobExcavationTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCh.descriptionZh: 我们要劫持一些采集机。在他们整备并发射时，Eudico 有些工作要你执行。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCu.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/CullJobAssassinateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCu.descriptionZh: 摧毁一个工人控制网络，然后杀死其监工。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCu.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/CullJobExterminateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCu.descriptionZh: Corpus 正在执行他们的部队演习训练。肆意破坏吧。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCu.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/CullJobResourceTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusCu.descriptionZh: 引开Corpus 的安保，然后掠夺他们储备的矿物堆。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusHe.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/HelpingJobCacheTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusHe.descriptionZh: 通风小子们需要组件来制作 K 式悬浮板。帮帮他们吧？

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusHe.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/HelpingJobResourceTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusHe.descriptionZh: 胁迫一名 Corpus 的调查员。让他远离我们的人民。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusHe.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/HelpingJobSpyTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusHe.descriptionZh: 一名航道特工正等候一艘在行星轨道上且满载补给的船舰。他需要登陆的许可证。帮他伪造一个来。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusIn.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/IntelJobRecoveryTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusIn.descriptionZh: 一支盯梢奈富特种作战部队的小队与我们失去了联络。找到他们并取回他们探查到的情报。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusIn.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/IntelJobResourceTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusIn.descriptionZh: 据说 Corpus 正在筹备多项行动。我们需要了解那些行动的进一步动向。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusIn.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/IntelJobSpyTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusIn.descriptionZh: 在奈富的索回小组进攻目标通道之前找出并清除关键的债务分类帐册。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusPr.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/PreservationJobDefenseTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusPr.descriptionZh: 巡逻山谷。回报任何异常情况。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusPr.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/PreservationJobRecoveryTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusPr.descriptionZh: 释放被奈富审讯单位抓走的索拉里斯人民。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusPr.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/PreservationJobResourceTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusPr.descriptionZh: 减少对 Corpus 饲育与研究部门的供应。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusSp.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/SpyJobSpyTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusSp.descriptionZh: 一名索联的特工失踪了。揭露他们的命运并阻止奈富的计划。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusTh.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/TheftJobAmbushTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusTh.descriptionZh: 线圈滚轮分配到巡逻哨定期上传资料。入侵一台来上传间谍病毒。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusTh.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/TheftJobExcavationTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusTh.descriptionZh: 税务官们的挖掘机已经发现一条主矿脉。我们需要那些矿产。去占为己有吧。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusWe.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/WetworkJobAssassinateTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusWe.descriptionZh: 追击并杀死臭名昭著的 Corpus 战争罪犯。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusWe.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisJobs/WetworkJobSpyTitle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Jobs/VenusWe.descriptionZh: 摧毁载有高价值 Corpus 目标的穿梭艇。
